name: Nemean
description: (Tag:magic-resistance+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are the Nemean Lion. You can switch between your base form, Lion Form, and anything in between. You gain indomitable physical stats and nigh-invulnerable skin even gods envy. Your skin defends against everything, and I mean everything, scaling with your physical stats. Even space-cutting, soul-burning, cursing, or existence-erasing attacks must contend with your resilience and have their effects reduced if not outright negated, depending on the attack's power relative to your defence.
